info.title: Geoapify Map Matching API
info.description: Snap ordered GPS measurements to a route on the routable road network.

servers.description: EU-focused endpoint. Geoapify service processing uses EU infrastructure.

post.summary: Match a GPS trace to the road network
post.description:
Snaps an ordered GPS trace to a plausible route on the routable road network.

- Send `mode` and 1–1,000 `waypoints` in a JSON body.
- Each waypoint `location` uses GeoJSON coordinate order: `[longitude, latitude]`.
- Optional timestamps help calculate effective speed and reject implausible measurements.
- Optional bearings describe recorded travel direction in degrees clockwise from north.
- Waypoint order is preserved; points may be matched, unmatched, interpolated, or merged.
- The response is a GeoJSON `FeatureCollection` with `MultiLineString` route geometry, matched waypoint metadata, legs, and road-level steps.

**Example:** a 35-point timestamped GPS trace matched with `mode=drive`.

requestBody.description: GPS trace and matching options. The request body must be JSON.

200.description: Matched GeoJSON route. The feature contains snapped route geometry, total distance and time, road-level steps, and one match record for each input waypoint.

400.description: Invalid JSON body or Map Matching input, such as missing required fields, too many waypoints, invalid coordinates, malformed timestamps, or bearings outside the supported range.

value.message: "waypoints" must contain less than or equal to 1000 items
"waypoints[0].bearing" must be less than or equal to 360

401.description: Missing or invalid Geoapify API key.

example.message: Request failed, please try again later

mode.description: Travel profile used to decide which roads can plausibly connect the GPS measurements. `drive` represents a passenger car.

waypoints.description: Ordered GPS measurements to match. Input order is preserved; the API does not optimize or reorder these points.

geocode_step_address.description: When `true`, reverse-geocodes matched route steps and adds address data. Each geocoded step adds API credit cost.

lookup_step_osmtags.description: When `true`, looks up OpenStreetMap tags for matched route steps. Each lookup step adds API credit cost.

lookup_osm_overlap.description: When `true`, includes OpenStreetMap overlap information for matched route steps. Each lookup step adds API credit cost.

lang.description: Language code used for any generated address or instruction text.

location.description: Recorded coordinate in GeoJSON order: `[longitude, latitude]`.

timestamp.description: Optional ISO 8601 recording time. Ordered timestamps help estimate speed and identify implausible measurements.

bearing.description: Optional recorded travel direction in degrees clockwise from north.

statusCode.description: HTTP status code returned by the API gateway.

ApiKeyInQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyInQuery.description: Geoapify API key query parameter. Recommended authentication method for public APIs. API keys in URLs can be logged; use x-api-key for server-to-server clients.

ApiKeyInHeader.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyInHeader.description: Geoapify API key header. Supported as an alternative authentication method for public APIs.
